name: colordict
description: The four instrument files for the ColorDict connotation dictionary: the Sense Ranker and Enricher that write an entry, and the Entry Reader and Null Auditor that read it blind. Packaged so a session that is not opened on the repo folder can still resolve them by name, with model and effort intact. These files are a measuring stick, not a starting point - a defect rate is only comparable to an older one if they did not move.
